title: PR #213: docs(catalog): reconcile latest GlobusOS runtime contracts
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Summary

- Add `FN-GLOBUS-004`, a residual, source-unbound contract for normalized hardware inventory based on GlobusOS PR #92.
- Record the proposed dependency-aware service-supervisor work from GlobusOS PR #96 as candidate evidence for `FN-GLOBUS-001`, not as a canonical mainline binding or functional verification.
- Update the human-readable catalog count to 31 components / 105 function contracts.

## Evidence boundaries

- JSON parsed successfully in the update workflow; no repository validator, CI, build, unit test, hardware probe, or source census was run by this change.
- PR #92 does not provide a verified exact source SHA/per-symbol binding in this catalog update, so `FN-GLOBUS-004` remains `UNBOUND_RESIDUAL`.
- PR #96 head `f7e118d9c5381f094ef70bc20ba59783d2372ade` is recorded only as a proposed candidate. Production x86_64 copy-in, real syscall/interrupt entry wiring, per-process CR3/page-table isolation, complete PT_LOAD/BSS mapping, and production `globus-init` remain open.
- No function is promoted to `VERIFIED`; the release decision remains `BLOCKED`.

## Required follow-up

1. Reconcile PR #92 against an exact head SHA, source path, symbol and blob SHA.
2. Run the catalog validator and exact-head CI, and inspect source-census/reconciliation results.
3. Keep this PR Draft until required evidence is terminal and independently reviewed.
